heuristics.owned: file under lib/<id>/ or whose basename names the id; owned files are not counted as coupling

refKinds.import: import/export ... from, dynamic import or require
refKinds.branch: equality or case against the quoted id ('qwen' === x, case 'qwen')
refKinds.literal: other quoted id (arrays, maps, ids passed as data)
refKinds.identifier: identifier or prose containing the id (qwenConfigured, resolveQwenCli)

heuristics.compositionRoots: references in COMPOSITION_ROOTS are listed under compositionRoots and excluded from coupling
heuristics.concerns: first match wins: tests/ and i18n/ by path; auth, usage_pricing, models by line then file name; settings_ui for app_front and *settings*; else capability
